title: cline-sentinel: one Windows notification when a Cline turn ends
description:
cline-sentinel reads the local Cline event database on Windows and sends one notification when a turn ends, fails, is aborted, or waits for a human. It does not notify on ordinary mid-run silence. The tool uses the Python standard library, opens the database read-only, and does not call a model, use the network, or rely on a hook or model memory.

Scope. The tested Cline builds did not provide a Windows turn-end notification. It supports Windows and the local Cline event database only. The database schema is a Cline implementation detail and may change. A notification proves that Windows accepted a call; it does not prove that a banner was displayed or seen. The guard has no layer below it. The approval-prompt path has not been separately verified.
